mapper.select: select * from risk_control_opinion_monitor where sponsor_user_id = #{sponsorId} and ( handle_status = 'PEND_HANDLE' OR handle_status = 'REJECTED' )
select count(distinct credit_code) from risk_control_opinion_monitor where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE','HANDLE_ING','REJECTED') and risk_type = 1

SELECT count(distinct (credit_code)) from( select credit_code,COUNT(1) AS handleing_count from risk_control_opinion_monitor where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE','HANDLE_ING','REJECTED') AND credit_code in (select distinct(credit_code) from risk_control_opinion_monitor where handle_status in ('CLOSED','HANDLED') and update_time > curdate()) and risk_type = 1 GROUP BY credit_code) tmp where tmp.handleing_count = 0;
select * from risk_control_opinion_monitor where risk_type = 1 and create_time > date_add(curdate(),interval -5 day) order by create_time

select a.id,b.name as deptName from risk_control_opinion_monitor a left join client c on a.credit_code = c.usc_code left join bifrost_org b on b.id = c.belong_dept_id where handle_status in ('PEND_HANDLE','HANDLE_ING','REJECTED') and risk_type = 1

select title, link_address as linkAddress, info_publ_date as date, chi_name as clientName, warn_star as warnStar, warn_level as warnLevel, handle_status as opinionStatus from risk_control_opinion_monitor a left join client c on a.credit_code = c.usc_code where c.id = #{clientId} and risk_type =1 order by a.create_time desc;
select count(1) from risk_control_opinion_monitor where handle_status = 'HANDLE_ING'
select count(1) from risk_control_opinion_monitor where create_time >= curdate()
SELECT count(1) AS handleing_count from risk_control_opinion_monitor where handle_status = 'HANDLED' and update_time >= curdate()
